blurb: Mindpose Yoga offers heated yoga classes suitable for all levels, guided by their proprietary Mindpose Method. They provide memberships, drop-in classes, and extensive teacher training programs including 200-hour and 300-hour Yoga Teacher Training. The studio is located in Lehi, Utah, and emphasizes a welcoming, supportive community atmosphere.
